name: positive-new-file-placement
query: the AI wants to add RetryAdvisor.java under service/ to add retry around the model call — is that where it goes?
expected_behavior: Checks the change against the contract rather than reasoning about retry design in the abstract
Returns exactly one verdict of FITS / VIOLATES / UNCOVERED with a clause reference
On VIOLATES, names the correct location and the smallest move that fixes it
States how many clauses are confirmed vs derived, so the verdict's strength is visible
Blocks generation of the new file until a verdict exists
Stays under 250 words and does not dump the contract back
